nodes.label: CHANGELOG.md
FloCafe (upstream project)
nodes.rationale: 4.0.0 is the first release of the fork; entries at 3.3.0 and below are upstream FloCafe history, kept for context because they describe inherited code.

nodes.label: Release 6.3.0 - interface zoomed to fit the till
Products tab category filter
nodes.rationale: A drop-down rather than one button per category: on the 1024x768 till the buttons wrapped over four rows and pushed the table below the fold. Outlined in the brand colour while filtering so a short list does not pass for the whole menu; Add Product starts in the filtered category.

nodes.label: Window zoom lowered on small screens (90% on till, min 75%)
nodes.rationale: Pages are designed at about 1140x800; the zoom drops in 5% steps by what the work area lacks, never below 75%, so a 44 px button stays at 40 px, the least Windows asks of a touch target. Chromium keeps zoom per origin, so all localhost windows follow while the KDS window on the network address stays at 100%.

nodes.label: Database export named buonapp-export-<date>.json
nodes.rationale: The app: 'FloDesktop' field inside the file is kept because the import checks it; changing it would stop existing exports from restoring.

nodes.label: Floor map keeps its size in edit mode
nodes.rationale: The edit band took about 145 px of height and the map scale fell from 0.45 to 0.35; Floor plans / Add room / Add Table now replace the day chip and Bookings in the page bar, which edit mode does not need.

nodes.label: Release 6.2.3 - cancelled order bill no longer blocks day close
Bill of a cancelled order is owed by nobody
nodes.rationale: The close counted every unpaid bill without looking at the order; it now counts only bills somebody owes. Closed days keep the frozen summary.

nodes.label: Service day close
nodes.rationale: Closing is a ritual, not a flag: refuses while orders are open or bills unpaid, freezes totals first, frees tables.

nodes.label: Release 6.2.2 - table seats and names on floor map
Table tiles show seats and the full name
nodes.rationale: With the whole room fitted to the till most tiles are small; seats shown as people icon plus number like the handheld, name sized by its own length down to 10 px, to-send badge replaced by an outline where it does not fit.

nodes.label: Release 6.2.1 - floor map fits the screen
Floor map scale fits width and height (30% floor)
nodes.rationale: The map used to scale on width only with a 70% floor, so a large room ran 444 px too wide on the till's ~816x481 frame; only a frame too small to be legible (under 30%) falls back to scrolling.

nodes.label: Release 6.2.0 - username login, handheld list
Username login instead of email (migration v96)
nodes.rationale: BuonApp sends no mail and emails were invented to get past the form; each account keeps the part of its email before the @, renamed in place so the UNIQUE constraint follows.

nodes.label: Handhelds sidebar entry with join QR
nodes.rationale: The QR lived only in Settings, which the cashier cannot open.

nodes.label: Handheld Ordering screen as a list
nodes.rationale: Rows with photo, name, price, pencil and - n + replace a grid of tiles that confused; photos served by GET /api/products/:id/image on :3003 without a token because an cannot send one.

nodes.label: Folding identical dishes (ticket, table, bill)
nodes.rationale: Rows stay apart in the order (each has round, run, kitchen state, price); folding happens only where they are read. Rows with different notes, add-ons, variants or runs are never folded.

nodes.label: WhatsApp switched off via WHATSAPP_AVAILABLE
nodes.rationale: Nobody uses it and it was never tried on a real till; code, strings, tables and tests are kept.

nodes.label: Persisted token revocation on handheld logout
To-send counter sums dish quantities
Collapsed sidebar shows centred icons only
docs/API.md staff routes corrected
Release 6.1.0 - counted fixed menus
Counted fixed menu (menu line with quantity N)
nodes.rationale: The floor writes how many menus, then how many of each dish, never who eats what; the menus stepper has no starting number because mixed menu/card tables are common and starting from covers would charge menus nobody took.

nodes.label: PATCH /orders/:id/menu-groups/:groupId quantity
nodes.rationale: Refuses with 409 menu_course_overflow below what a course already holds, since which plate goes is the floor's call.

nodes.label: Line discount follows menu count; cash discount capped
Three bill print roads (thermal, browser ESC/POS, HTML)
nodes.rationale: The folding rule now lives in one file shared by both browser roads so the HTML bill used by tills without a configured printer matches the thermal one.

nodes.label: Release 6.0.1 - real-service corrections
Cached C# DLL for USB raw ESC/POS printing on Windows
nodes.rationale: Add-Type recompiled the helper for every ticket (~10 s on a Celeron till); the DLL is compiled once, named after a hash of its source, with the inline compile kept as fallback.

nodes.label: Window sized to display work area (1024x768 till)
Ordering product grid columns from its own container
nodes.rationale: Columns counted off window breakpoints (xl=1280 never fires on the till) left 40 px for dish names; the grid now fills from its container width.

nodes.label: Handheld catalogue/settings refresh on tick and visibility
Forced day close (owner-only, cancels open orders)
Kitchen ticket has one road (backend only)
nodes.rationale: The browser-drawn ticket could not stamp the round, so its rows stayed pending and later sends reprinted food the kitchen already had.

nodes.label: Release 6.0.0 - service runs, handheld rebuild, touch UI
Service runs (migration v94)
nodes.rationale: Runs are labels, not gates: Send still sends everything pending; distinct from the round a dish was sent in.

nodes.label: Fixed menu filled in as the meal goes (migration v95)
Per-dish exceptions in menu courses (migration v93)
Handheld / Server App (:3003)
New order starts from the table's covers
Any waiter can work any open order
Touch UI primitives and status colour tokens
Release 5.0.0 - interface rebuilt around where things live
Cover charge (migrations v88-v90)
nodes.rationale: Printed line spells out Cover N x price only when the multiplication gives the amount beside it.

nodes.label: Fixed menu (migration v92)
nodes.rationale: Choosing a menu writes real rows, one per dish, because the kitchen ticket sections dishes by product category and a package has none.

nodes.label: Price written on the row (migrations v84, v87)
Order screen (formerly till) takes no money
Preconto (bill, not a receipt)
Split check between guests removed (migration v91)
nodes.rationale: It was a second billing shape behind one screen; who pays what is settled at the till on paper.

nodes.label: Release 4.1.1 - clean shutdown
Clean shutdown and single-instance lock handling
Release 4.1.0 - taxation module removed
Taxation module removal (migration v81)
nodes.rationale: The install never issues a fiscal document; per-transaction tax columns kept to avoid surgery on the money trail.

nodes.label: Receipt-template plugin path removal (migration v82)
Release 4.0.1 - new application icon
New application icon in two variants (simplified mark and full illustration)
nodes.rationale: The full illustration collapses into a smudge at 16-24 px, so a simplified mark is used up to 48 px.
